title: Paint Calculator
description: Find out how many gallons of paint and primer you need for any room, using standard 350 sq ft per gallon coverage.
keywords: how much paint do i need
howto: Measure your walls and enter the total paintable area in square feet.
Choose the number of coats (2 is standard over a new color).
Read how many gallons to buy, plus primer and the metric equivalent.

faqs.q: What does 350 sq ft per gallon assume?
faqs.a: One coat on a smooth, primed interior wall. Rough, porous or unprimed surfaces can drop coverage to 250-300 sq ft per gallon.

faqs.q: Should I buy exactly the calculated amount?
faqs.a: Buy the rounded-up gallon count shown. Paint is sold in whole gallons or quarts, and a little extra covers touch-ups.

faqs.q: How much primer do I need?
faqs.a: Roughly one coat of primer over the same area, so about half the paint volume for a two-coat job.
